purpose: Discovery and provenance registry for historical Mobile Bay Jubilee event evidence. Discovery is not ingestion; each source must be normalized into event_evidence before calibration use.

sources.title: Sporadic Mass Shoreward Migrations of Demersal Fish and Crustaceans in Mobile Bay, Alabama
sources.author: Harold Loesch
sources.use: historical event dates, seasonality, location, timing, wind/rain/tide hypotheses
sources.guardrail: Do not create 37 individual event rows until the primary event table/text is recovered.

sources.title: Extensive oxygen depletion in Mobile Bay, Alabama
sources.author: Edwin B. May
sources.use: dated spatial DO observations, bathymetric low-oxygen storage and nearshore-contact physics
sources.guardrail: Hypoxia observations are not automatically Jubilee events.

sources.title: Curtis Graf with a flounder he gigged during a jubilee in Point Clear, Alabama
sources.archive: Alabama Department of Archives and History, Alabama Media Group Collection
sources.location: Point Clear / approximately four miles south of Grand Hotel
sources.use: exact historical Point Clear event label and scale evidence
sources.reported_details: Caption calls it one of the largest jubilees; Emile Graf Jr. and Curtis Graf reportedly caught more than 60 flounders.
sources.guardrail: Reported catch size is harvest evidence, not the full event spatial boundary.

sources.title: Taul Tuveson with a flounder he gigged during a jubilee between Daphne and Montrose
sources.archive: Alabama Department of Archives and History, Alabama Media Group Collection
sources.event_date_basis: caption says early Tuesday morning; publication was Wednesday 1972-08-16; calendar inference
sources.use: historical Eastern Shore event label, pre-dawn timing, duration and spatial extent
sources.reported_details: small flounder-and-crab jubilee began before daylight and lasted one or two hours between Daphne and Montrose
sources.guardrail: Retain event_date_basis because the exact date is inferred from the archival caption and calendar rather than printed explicitly in the caption.

sources.title: The Jubilee phenomenon
sources.author: T. Lowery
sources.use: historical mechanism/location synthesis and cited event sources

sources.title: Jubilee
sources.use: historical Point Clear positive with exact date, morning timing, coordinates and species
sources.reported_details: David A. Bagwell states a Jubilee occurred that morning at Point Clear and gives N 30°31'21", W 87°54'10"; flounder, crabs, shrimp, stingrays, mullet and other fish are described.

sources.title: Eastern Shore Jubilee - Point Clear 08/16/13
sources.use: historical Eastern Shore positive with date, location, early/daybreak timing, species and photographs
sources.reported_details: small Jubilee; reports of good flounder early; by daybreak small flounder, crabs, stingrays and schools of catfish

sources.title: Jubilee!
sources.use: historical event lead and local creek/freshwater-front hypothesis generation
sources.guardrail: Do not use as a calibration positive until the exact event date and shoreline cell are independently resolved.

sources.title: Effects of Coastal Upwelling and Downwelling on Hydrographic Variability and Dissolved Oxygen in Mobile Bay
